readme.html:
Awesome OSINT MCP Servers

A curated list of MCP servers for OSINT (Open Source Intelligence).

An MCP server connects tools and services to LLM systems like Claude, Cursor, Windsurf, etc.
MCP servers simplify execution of OSINT tools by combining them with the ease of LLM querying
and the ability to create flexible reports.

Legend: 📦 Open Source  ·  🆓 Free / Has Free Tier  ·  💰 Paid / Requires Paid API

Contents

  • SOCMINT
  • Network Scanning
  • Web Scraping
  • Company Intelligence
  • Public Records & Compliance
  • Threat Intelligence
  • Geospatial & Geopolitical Intelligence
  • Research Intelligence
  • Media Verification & Provenance
  • Meta / Discovery
  • Blockchain Intelligence
  • Market & Trading

SOCMINT

  • 🆓💰 Arcmira — Find public statements across indexed YouTube videos, with transcript passages and source timestamps. Requires Arcmira sign-in or an API key; free tier and paid plans. MCP: https://mcp.arcmira.com/mcp

  • 💰 Expose Team — AI-powered OSINT at lightspeed. Credit-based plans from $8/month.

  • 📦🆓 Consensus OSINT — Local MCP server for username, email, phone and web-page lookups, with structured, paginated results. 7 tools. Install the mcp extra and run consensus mcp --transport stdio; optional providers may need credentials.

  • 📦🆓 Maigret — Collect user account information from various public sources by username.

  • 📦💰 Xquik — X (Twitter) data extraction and automation with 40+ REST API endpoints, real-time account monitoring, and trending topics. MCP server with API key auth.

  • 📦💰 TwitterAPIs MCP — Tweet search, user profiles, followers, timelines and account monitoring on X without an X developer account — 68 read tools, plus 44 that post and act as the connected account. One API key, pay per call at $0.0008 with $0.50 of starter credit. MCP: https://www.twitterapis.com/mcp

  • 📦💰 TweetAPI MCP — Read-only Twitter data: tweet search, profiles, About this account (location, username history), followers, lists, communities and Spaces. 33 live tools plus docs tools. Hosted with OAuth, or local over stdio with a TweetAPI key. MCP: https://mcp.tweetapi.com/mcp

  • 📦🆓 OSINT Tools MCP — Wraps seven classic OSINT CLIs behind one server: Sherlock and Blackbird (usernames), Maigret, Holehe (email), GHunt (Google accounts), theHarvester (domains) and SpiderFoot. Python, installs the underlying tools itself.

  • 📦🆓 OSINT Toolbox MCP — Runs 12 OSINT tools on your machine: Sherlock, Maigret and Blackbird (usernames), Holehe and GHunt (email), theHarvester, SpiderFoot, subfinder, dnsrecon and dnstwist (domains), PhoneInfoga (phone numbers) and ExifTool (file metadata), plus built-in WHOIS, DNS, crt.sh and Wayback lookups (17 MCP tools in all). No API keys; uvx package or Docker image.

  • 📦🆓 LinkedIn MCP — Search LinkedIn people, companies and jobs, and pull structured profile, company and post data. Uses your own session cookie; no API key.

  • 🆓💰 BulkTranscripts — YouTube channel uploads, in-channel topic search, and full transcripts as clean text. get_latest_videos is unmetered — poll it to watch a subject's channel and spend credits only on what is new. Hosted, 7 tools, no signup; 30 free credits shared per public IP, then one-time packs. MCP: https://bulktranscripts.co/mcp

  • 🆓💰 LinkMCP — LinkedIn research and automation through your own account: profile and company lookup, people, job and Sales Navigator search, posts, comments and inbox, work email and mobile lookup. It also writes — messages, connection requests, posts and reactions. 35 tools. Free trial covers lookups; connecting LinkedIn needs a plan from $19/month. MCP: https://app.linkmcp.io/api/mcp

  • 📦🆓💰 Reddit Scraper MCP — Search Reddit by keyword and pull posts, full comment threads, subreddits and a user's post and comment history as JSON. 3 tools; npx package (reddit-scraper-mcp). Needs an Apify token; no Reddit API key. Pay per result, the Apify free plan covers small runs.

  • 📦🆓💰 Kooperativa.io — Enrich and search professional profiles and companies from the Kooperativa.io data API: work history, headcount by seniority, hiring signals and job changes. 24 tools over stdio; needs a Kooperativa.io API key (7-day free trial).

  • 🆓💰 TubeText YouTube Transcripts — Transcripts of YouTube videos, Shorts, playlists or whole channels (Whisper fallback when captions are missing), plus channel stats and Social Blade history. Apify sign-in (OAuth); pay per result with a free monthly credit. MCP: https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=fetch-actor-details,tubetext/youtube-transcript-fast,tubetext/youtube-channel-analytics,tubetext/socialblade-scraper

  • 🆓💰 GetYouTubeTranscript — Full transcripts of YouTube videos, YouTube and in-channel search, and a channel's or playlist's video list. Polling a channel's latest uploads is free, so you only spend credits on new videos. Hosted, 7 tools, OAuth or API key; 100 free credits. MCP: https://getyoutubetranscript.com/api/mcp

  • 🆓💰 LurkAPI — Public profiles, posts, comments, video transcripts and ad library entries from TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Reddit, X, LinkedIn and 10 more platforms, read without logging in. 89 tools. Hosted, OAuth or API key; 100 free credits, then paid packs. MCP: https://api.lurkapi.com/mcp

  • 💰 TikTok Scraper — Collect public TikTok videos, creator profiles, comments and follower lists for social-media research. Returns engagement counts and publication dates. No TikTok login; requires an Apify account and is paid per result. MCP: https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=harshmaur/tiktok-scraper

Network Scanning

  • 📦🆓💰 Shodan — Query the Shodan API and CVEDB for IP reconnaissance, DNS operations, vulnerability tracking, and device discovery. Free tier available with limited queries, requires Shodan API key.
  • 📦🆓💰 ZoomEye — Obtain network asset information by querying ZoomEye using dorks and other search parameters. 7-day free trial available, requires ZoomEye API key.
  • 📦🆓 DNSTwist — DNS fuzzing tool that helps detect typosquatting, phishing, and corporate espionage.
  • 📦🆓 OSINT Toolkit — Unified interface for network reconnaissance with parallel execution of WHOIS, Nmap, DNS lookups, and typosquatting detection.
  • 📦🆓💰 ContrastAPI — Security intelligence server with 49 tools: domain recon (DNS, WHOIS, SSL, subdomains, WAF, Wayback) plus orchestrated audit_domain, IP reputation plus orchestrated threat_report (Shodan + AbuseIPDB + ASN), CVE/EPSS/KEV lookup plus calculate_risk_score (CVSS+EPSS+KEV+PoC fusion) and bulk_cve_lookup (50/call), cve_leading (MITRE/GHSA pre-NVD), IOC enrichment plus bulk_ioc_lookup (50/call), threat intel, MITRE ATLAS (167 AI/ML attack techniques + bulk drill) and D3FEND defenses (149 techniques + coverage report), web intelligence (robots.txt, redirect chain, email validation, brand assets, SEO audit), check_dependencies (requirements.txt / package.json audit), and code security scanning. Anonymous tier + Pro tier with API key.
  • 🆓💰 DomScan — Domain intelligence with DNS, WHOIS/RDAP, SSL/TLS, subdomain enumeration, certificate search, typosquatting and brand monitoring, plus domain valuation and availability. One API and MCP server; free tools with paid API tiers.
  • 🆓💰 CrawlGraph — Passive web footprinting via the Common Crawl webgraph - mapping which sites reference a target, without ever touching the target (passive, no active scanning). Two tools for OSINT research: inbound linking to target and link-gap between two or more targets. npx -y crawlgraph-mcp. Free sign up for 15 targets/mo ; paid lifetime API for higher limits and link-gap research.
  • 🆓💰 DomainKits — Search newly registered, expired, and dropped domains across gTLDs for phishing, typosquatting, and brand-impersonation monitoring, with WHOIS, DNS, reverse-nameserver, IP geolocation, and Google Safe Browsing lookups. Requires paid API key.
  • 📦🆓 IPInfo — IP geolocation, ASN and network details, Tor exit-node checks, and interactive maps for sets of IPs via ipinfo.io. Free API token required.
  • 📦🆓💰 IPGeolocation.io — 17 tools for accurate IP geolocation, company information, ASN and network data, IP security (VPN, proxy, Tor, bot, hosting and spam detection), abuse contacts, time zones, astronomy, currency data and user-agent parsing. Local stdio server; API key for authenticated lookups, with free and paid plans.
  • 🆓💰 Vend — Pay-per-call web and domain intelligence: IP geolocation, domain WHOIS/DNS/SSL, link health and status checks, web search, and clean page extraction. No signup, no API key; settle per call in Nano (XNO). MCP: https://extract.paypercall.dev/mcp
  • 📦💰 StackScan — Technographic lookups over 360M+ sites: what a domain is built on, who is behind it (industry, city, country, LinkedIn), and how many sites run a given technology and where. Batch domain lookup for list enrichment. Local stdio server, MIT, npx -y @stackscan/mcp-server. Charged per resolving domain; misses are not charged and check_credits is free.
  • 🆓💰 IP99 — Risk score and geolocation for any IPv4/IPv6 address: proxy, VPN, dial-up pool and datacenter signals, each with the age of the evidence behind it, plus ASN, usage type and city. One MCP tool, no API key, 500 lookups/day; the same backend also serves passive DNS, CT and new-domain feeds over HTTP. MCP: https://ip99.com/mcp
  • 📦💰 MCP Toolbelt — Hosted MCP server for domain and network reconnaissance: WHOIS and DNS lookups, subdomain discovery, SSL/TLS checks, open-port and ASN lookups, plus security-header and exposed-file audits for attack-surface mapping. 29 tools, pay per call in USDC via x402, no API key or account required. MCP: https://papacasper.com/mcp
  • 📦🆓💰 APIVerve — Domain, IP and contact enrichment behind one key: WHOIS, DNS and reverse DNS, subdomains, SSL certificates, IP geolocation and ASN, Tor/VPN/proxy and blacklist checks, phishing-domain checks, email and phone validation, password breach checks and sanctions screening. Requires an API key; free tier and paid plans. MCP: https://api.apiverve.com/v1/mcp
  • 📦🆓 Subdomain Finder MCP — Passive subdomain enumeration from certificate transparency logs (certspotter, crt.sh), with DNS over HTTPS checks that flag live hosts and dangling CNAMEs, plus certificate history per host. No API key. MCP: https://subdomain-finder-mcp.lipmichal.workers.dev/mcp
  • 📦🆓💰 WhoisFreaks — 14 tools: live and historical WHOIS, reverse WHOIS, IP and ASN WHOIS, live, historical and reverse DNS, subdomains, domain discovery and availability, IP geolocation and security, and SSL lookups. Java (stdio) or Docker (SSE); API key with 500 free credits on signup, then paid plans.

Web Scraping

  • 🆓💰 Anysite — Live structured data from 900+ sources (LinkedIn, X, Instagram, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, company registries, SEC, etc.): discover endpoints, execute them, then filter, merge and export results server-side. 7-day free trial (card required), then from $30/month. MCP: https://mcp.anysite.io/mcp
  • 📦🆓💰 Bright Data — Real-time web search, scraping, and structured data extraction from 60+ sources (Amazon, LinkedIn, TikTok, Google Maps, etc.) with CAPTCHA and anti-bot bypass. Free tier: 5,000 requests/month.
  • 🆓💰 Parallel Search MCP — Web search and page-content extraction (web_search, web_fetch) for LLM agents. Default endpoint works without an API key; an account with credits is needed for production rate limits. MCP: https://search.parallel.ai/mcp
  • 🆓💰 You.com — Web search and page-content extraction for LLM agents, plus managed multi-step research. The free profile works with no signup or API key; an API key adds page-content reads and research tools. MCP: https://api.you.com/mcp?profile=free
  • 📦🆓 Wayback Machine MCP — Query and save Internet Archive snapshots: check archive status, fetch archived URLs, search the CDX index, and compare two snapshots of a page. No API key for reads. npx -y mcp-wayback-machine
  • 📦🆓💰 Singapore Proxy MCP — Fetch pages and run Google searches (gl=sg) from a real Singapore mobile IP on Singtel or M1, and rotate the IP on demand, to see what Singapore users are served. Requires an API key; 24-hour free trial, then paid. MCP: https://mcp.singaporemobileproxy.com/mcp
  • 🆓💰 Zyte MCP — Fetch pages with ban avoidance, render them in a browser and take screenshots, extract product, article and job data with AI, and search the web as seen from a chosen country. Free to use, with usage billed at Zyte API prices and $5 of trial credit for a month. OAuth sign-in. MCP: https://mcp.zyte.com/v1/mcp
  • 🆓💰 CurlShot — Capture a public web page as evidence: full-page PNG/JPEG/WebP, a PDF, or a video of the page scrolling, on phone or desktop presets, with cookie banners and ads hidden. Requires an API key; free plan 100 screenshots/month. MCP: https://curlshot.com/api/mcp
  • 🆓 Keenable — Web search (search_web_pages) that can be scoped to one site and a publication-date window, plus page fetch as markdown (fetch_page_content). No API key needed (1,000 requests/hour per IP); an optional key removes the hourly cap. MCP: https://api.keenable.ai/mcp
  • 📦🆓💰 Firecrawl MCP — Research people, companies and domains from their public pages: search the web, then scrape, crawl or map sites into Markdown, including JS-heavy pages and PDFs. Search and scrape work keyless (rate-limited); a free API key adds crawl and map. MCP: https://mcp.firecrawl.dev/v2/mcp
  • 🆓💰 Serply MCP — Google web, News, Jobs and Scholar search with site:/filetype: operators passed through, plus Bing, page scraping and Reddit lookups (subreddit posts, full threads, a user's post and comment history). Requires an API key; 2,500 free credits for 30 days. MCP: https://api.serply.io/mcp
  • 📦🆓💰 AgentSearch MCP — Live web search, any URL to clean Markdown, and JS-heavy page rendering for researching people, companies and domains from public pages. Search is keyless (up to 25/day per IP); extract, render and paid search are $0.005 per call. npx -y @agentsearchhq/agentsearch-mcp
  • 🆓💰 Bowmark — Live structured data from 750+ sites (LinkedIn, X, Instagram, Reddit, YouTube and more) through a library of tested functions: find one with get_library, call it with run, get typed JSON back. Needs a Bowmark account; starts with a free $10. MCP: https://api.bowmark.ai/mcp

Company Intelligence

  • 📦🆓💰 CompanyScope — Company intelligence aggregating data from 8 public sources (Wikipedia, SEC EDGAR, OpenCorporates, RDAP, GitHub, and more) for corporate reconnaissance. Free tier 25 calls/day, pay-per-use tier on Apify.
  • 📦🆓 StockScope — SEC EDGAR financial intelligence for stock research. Revenue, net income, margins, filings, and company comparisons for any US public company. Free, no API key needed.
  • 🆓💰 FilingFirehose — Hosted SEC EDGAR MCP for any US ticker: 8-K body-text parsing (catches buried items beyond what the filer reported), 10-K / 10-Q / S-3 / Schedule 13D reads, forensic risk scoring (LOW/MODERATE/ELEVATED/HIGH), and cyber-incident tracking. Free public endpoints + paid tiers from $9/mo. MCP: https://filingfirehose.com/mcp
  • 📦🆓💰 OpenSOSData — US business entity search across all 53 Secretary of State jurisdictions (50 states, DC, Puerto Rico, US Virgin Islands): name search, status checks and batch lookups over a 33M-entity index. First 10 lookups free on signup, then from $0.0314 each. npx -y @opensosdata/mcp-server
  • 🆓💰 OpenRegistry — Real-time access to 27 national corporate registries worldwide (UK Companies House, France Sirene, Germany Handelsregister, South Korea OPENDART, Australia ABR, Canada Corporations, etc.) via a unified JSON schema. Returns company profiles, officers, shareholders, beneficial ownership, filings, and raw documents. Free tier: 20 rpm without signup, 30 rpm with email. Paid up to $29/mo. OAuth 2.1, no API keys.
  • 📦💰 Checko MCP — Unofficial wrapper for the Russian Checko.ru API: verify counterparties (companies, sole proprietors, individuals) via EGRUL/EGRIP, arbitration cases, government contracts (44-FZ/223-FZ), Rosstat financials, inspections, Fedresurs and EFRSB bankruptcy records. 12 tools and 6 ready-made workflow prompts. Requires paid CHECKO_API_KEY.
  • 🆓 Fylings — African company intelligence across 18+ official national registries (Nigeria's CAC, Tanzania's BRELA, Mauritius's CBRD, Senegal's RCCM, and more) via a unified schema, with the official registry source and a last-verified date on every record. Company search & verification, beneficial ownership, government-contract awards, and sanctions screening. Free, no API key. Hosted MCP: https://www.fylings.com/api/mcp
  • 📦🆓 Companies House MCP — 38 tools over the UK Companies House API: company and officer search, profiles, filing history and documents, charges, insolvency, PSC/beneficial ownership and disqualifications. Free API key required. AGPL-3.0.
  • 💰 Reestri — Public company registers of Georgia (country) and Armenia: NAPR company lookup and person-to-companies search, Armenian state register with official beneficial-owner declarations (BODS) and public-contract exposure, plus a one-call screen across Georgia, Armenia and Moldova. Remote streamable-HTTP MCP via Apify, pay per lookup.
  • 🆓 Auregistre — Dated history of a French company by SIREN, from the official BODACC gazette since 2008: changes of name, seat, capital and activity, insolvency judgments, filed accounts, ADEME grants and state aid. No key, no account. MCP: https://auregistre.fr/api/mcp
  • 📦🆓 open-data-mcp — Free local stdio MCP with official open-data tools: EU VAT (VIES) + LEI (GLEIF), French Sirene and Nordic company registries, TED tenders, PubMed, ClinicalTrials.gov, NHTSA VIN recalls and more. No API key for basic tools. MIT. npm ci && node src/index.js
  • 💰 Company Social Profile Finder — Resolves a company name, website or Google Maps listing to its LinkedIn, X, YouTube, Instagram and Facebook handles, with the evidence behind each link. Hosted on Apify; needs an Apify account (OAuth or API token). MCP: https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=publicrecords/company-social-profile-finder
  • 💰 Crunchbase Company API — Unofficial wrapper for Crunchbase company data: funding rounds, investors, headcount range, founders and key people. Hosted on Apify; needs an Apify account (OAuth or API token). MCP: https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=johnvc/crunchbase-company-api

Public Records & Compliance

  • 🆓💰 Carrier Ledger — Look up U.S. trucking companies and freight brokers in FMCSA public records; every fact cites the FMCSA dataset it came from. Read-only, not affiliated with FMCSA. MCP: https://carrierledger.tryneverclosed.com/mcp
  • 🆓💰 DataNexus MCP — Public records intelligence across 7 domains: domain recon (RDAP, DNS, SSL, subdomains, email security), patent search & inventor portfolios (EPO/WIPO), US government contract awards & vendor history (SAM.gov), regulatory filings & dockets (Regulations.gov + Federal Register), US/UK nonprofit 990 data & health scores, CVE/SBOM/EPSS vulnerability intelligence, and professional licence verification (NPI, FINRA, SAM exclusions). 55 tools, no API key required for free tier, hosted remote MCP.
  • 🆓💰 Edgrapi — Five official US sources on one key, as flat JSON: SAM.gov opportunities, USAspending awards, Grants.gov, House STOCK Act trades and SEC EDGAR filings. 19 read-only tools, each record links back to source. Congressional trades lag 45 days, House only. 50 free credits, then from $10/mo. MCP: https://api.edgrapi.com/mcp
  • 📦🆓💰 National ID & Tax ID Validator — Validate and decode national IDs, tax, company and VAT numbers, passport numbers and MRZ: 222 types across 108 countries, returning what the number encodes — birth date, sex, region, citizenship, taxpayer type. Structure and checksum only, no registry is queried, so valid means well-formed rather than real. uvx --from git+https://github.com/soxoj/national-id-mcp national-id-mcp
  • 📦💰 Nummeropslag — Privacy-first Danish phone-number intelligence using official CVR and telecom-register data. Look up registered companies, operators, number types, and community spam/trust signals without exposing private individuals' names. Requires a paid API key.
  • 📦💰 Open Data Actors MCP — Typed tools over public-record sources: sanctions screening, SEC Form D filings, new business filings, FMCSA carrier census, WARN layoff notices, city council agendas, domain WHOIS/DNS/SSL. Bring your own Apify token; each call is pay-per-result on your account. MCP: https://open-data-actors-mcp.vercel.app/mcp
  • 🆓💰 RestoSignals — Find US restaurants and bars before they open: fuses public liquor-license applications, food-service permits and new-business filings into one scored venue with the owner named in the filings. NY, TX, IL, CA deepest; OR, CO, WA lighter. 4 tools; free API key. MCP: https://api.restosignals.com/mcp
  • 📦🆓 Sanctions Screening MCP — Screen names against the consolidated OFAC, EU, UK and UN sanctions lists, resolve companies to GLEIF LEIs, and trace ownership chains. Mirrors the lists into a local SQLite/FTS5 index, so matching runs offline with no API key and no rate limit; hits carry a raw Jaro-Winkler score and source provenance rather than a verdict. npx -y @cyanheads/sanctions-screening-mcp-server
  • 📦🆓 Sift — 80 tools for cross-referencing public financial and corporate records across 9 sources: OpenSanctions, the ICIJ Offshore Leaks database (via Aleph), UK Companies House, SEC EDGAR, CourtListener, GLEIF, Wikidata and land registries. Ships 24 structural detection patterns (shell companies, nominee shields, phoenix companies, circular ownership) and interactive network graphs. Free OpenSanctions API key required.
  • 📦🆓 ForeclosureListings — US foreclosure resources by city and state: county trustee and sheriff sale pages, notice postings, HUD-approved counselors and legal aid, each fact citing its public source page and the date checked. 6 read-only tools, no key. MCP: https://foreclosurelistings.fyi/mcp

Threat Intelligence

  • 📦🆓 VirusTotal — Analyze URLs, files (by hash), IPs, and domains with detailed relationship mapping. Free API tier available, requires VIRUSTOTAL_API_KEY.
  • 📦🆓 Voidly — Global internet censorship intelligence: 116 tools across 119+ countries. Query OONI / IODA / CensoredPlanet evidence, look up 5,356 citable incidents, check if a domain or service is blocked in a country, fetch ISP-level risk scores, run ML-driven shutdown forecasts, and verify censorship claims. Free, no API key needed for read endpoints. npx @voidly/mcp-server.
  • 📦🆓 OpenOSINT — AI-powered OSINT agent with interactive REPL, MCP server, and CLI.
  • 📦🆓 osint-agent-skills — 23 MCP tools (DNS, Shodan InternetDB, crt.sh, Wayback CDX, GitHub code search, OTX, HIBP, Etherscan, Mastodon) with zero-dependency Node.js server for Claude Code, Cursor, and Ollama.
  • 📦🆓 VulneraMCP — AI-powered bug bounty MCP server with recon (subfinder, httpx, gau, ffuf), vulnerability testing (XSS/SQLi/IDOR/CSRF), API/auth/cloud scanning, knowledge-graph analysis, and Markdown reporting. Integrates OWASP ZAP and CLI tools with PostgreSQL storage.
  • 📦🆓 Clearfront — Self-OSINT footprint scanner exposing 30 tools over MCP: username enumeration (Sherlock, Maigret, WhatsMyName), email and breach checks (holehe, HIBP, Hudson Rock infostealer logs), domain and IP recon (crt.sh, Shodan, Censys, GreyNoise, Wayback Machine), and EXIF/GPS extraction. Correlates findings into an evidence graph and rates each by source, confidence and severity. Configurable sweep depth and a local web console. pip install clearfront, runs locally, most tools keyless.
  • 📦🆓 ScanMalware — Submit a URL for sandboxed browser analysis, then pivot across the scan archive: search by domain, IP, ASN, JARM, favicon mmh3, TLSH/ssdeep fuzzy hash, screenshot hash, OCR text, or JavaScript fingerprint. Also exposes YARA matches, TLS/RDAP records, Certificate Transparency pivots, detected technologies, and pastejacking/clipboard events. 128 tools, no API key required. MCP: https://mcp.scanmalware.com/mcp
  • 📦🆓 Darknet MCP — 66 tools for dark web and breach intelligence: ransomware group tracking and victim listings, stealer logs, HIBP breach lookups, IntelX search, Tor .onion fetching and exit-node checks, MalwareBazaar/ThreatFox/URLhaus feeds, and Bitcoin address intel. Many tools work with no API key; premium sources unlock with your own keys. npx darknet-mcp-server
  • 📦🆓 OpenCTI MCP — Natural-language access to an OpenCTI instance: latest reports, campaigns by name, attack patterns, indicators, labels and marking definitions over the GraphQL API. Requires your own OpenCTI URL and token.
  • 📦🆓💰 ThreatCluster — Clustered incident records from 20,000+ sources, validated IOCs, CVE lookup and ransomware leak-site victims. 10 tools. Needs a free API key: 100 credits a day, 30 requests a minute, 7-day lookback. npx -y threatcluster-mcp
  • 📦🆓 XposedOrNot — XposedOrNot data breach lookups for emails and domains: the breaches an address appears in, its full breach history, the public breach catalog, domain exposure counts and recent breaches. Read-only, never returns passwords, no API key. MCP: https://api.xposedornot.com/mcp
  • 📦🆓 Vulnerability Exposure — Checks a public IP, domain, CVE ID or software version for confirmed vulnerabilities: NVD version ranges, CISA KEV, EPSS, distro backports, Shodan and published exploits. 16 tools, runs locally over stdio; every API key is optional.
  • 📦🆓 CRED-1 — Local lookup of news-domain credibility: 2,600+ domains from public source-rating lists (OpenSources, Iffy.news) labeled fake, unreliable, mixed, conspiracy or satire, with a 0 to 1 score. 5 tools (check_domain, batch_check, search_domains, get_stats, get_categories); npx -y @aloth/cred1 --mcp, no API key. CC BY 4.0, weekly releases.

Geospatial & Geopolitical Intelligence

  • 📦🆓 World Intel MCP — 120 tools for real-time global situational awareness across 30+ domains: GDELT and 119 RSS news feeds, ACLED conflict events, military aircraft tracking (ADS-B/OpenSky), NGA maritime warnings, submarine cables and datacenters, OFAC sanctions, USGS/NASA disaster feeds, plus geospatial datasets for bases, ports, pipelines and nuclear facilities. All sources are free public APIs; optional free keys (FRED, EIA, NASA FIRMS, ACLED, OpenSky) unlock a few of them. Python, installed from source.
  • 📦🆓 Satellite MCP — 171 tools across 27 categories of geospatial intelligence: Sentinel-2 and Landsat scene search, NASA FIRMS wildfire detections, night-lights change detection, aircraft and vessel tracking, military and conflict data, sanctions, terrain and OpenStreetMap queries, plus spectral and change-detection math. Most tools need no key; premium imagery (Planet, NASA Earthdata, N2YO) uses your own. npx satellite-mcp
  • 📦🆓 GDELT MCP — Search and analyse global news coverage through the GDELT Project: article search, coverage timelines and breakdowns, tone distribution, and US television transcripts with clip, context and trending queries. No API key. npx -y @cyanheads/gdelt-mcp-server
  • 📦🆓 Velocity — Self-hosted flight and ship tracker whose MCP server answers from live public ADS-B and AIS feeds: aircraft and vessels in an area (circle or polygon), GPS-jamming cells, dossiers and track history, each contact with the feed that reported it and its fix age. Needs your own Velocity instance; no API keys.

Research Intelligence

  • 🆓💰 BGPT MCP — Scientific paper search with structured full-text evidence: methods, sample sizes, results, limitations, quality scores, and falsification prompts. Useful for claim verification and literature OSINT. Remote MCP + REST. Free tier: 50 results, then $0.02 per result. MCP: https://bgpt.pro/mcp/sse
  • 🆓 StatOrigin — Free, verified statistics for 32 industries; every figure cites its primary source (publisher, report, page and quote), useful for claim verification and citation checking. Remote streamable-HTTP MCP: https://statorigin.org/mcp

Media Verification & Provenance

  • 🆓 isGenAI — Checks images, web pages and text for recorded evidence of AI use: C2PA Content Credentials (signature validation and signer trust reported separately), IPTC AI labels, AI-use statements, prompts saved by AUTOMATIC1111/ComfyUI/InvokeAI/NovelAI, and EXIF/XMP metadata, quoting each source. 5 read-only tools, no API key.
